rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a poor-quality early blastocyst/0DD, noting limited expansion and poorly defined ICM/TE, but includes some uncertainty and potentially speculative comments about collapse/zona visibility from a single image.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, endometriosis, and repeated failed cycles well, with appropriate emphasis that embryo quality is the main limiting factor.

Reasoning is mostly logical and the low implantation estimate follows from poor morphology plus prior failures, though there is mild inconsistency in describing the embryo as both fair-poor and possibly image-limited.

Largely aligned with IVF practice and Gardner grading interpretation, with appropriate caution about morphology limits and selective discussion of PGT-A; some recommendations are broader/speculative rather than strictly guideline-driven.
Provides practical next steps for proceeding with transfer if this is the only embryo and outlines sensible future workup and cycle-planning options, though some suggestions remain somewhat general.
